rules: A leg listed here that is RED on the tectonic backend is not a CI failure; a red leg NOT listed here is a failure exactly as before.
A leg listed here that is GREEN on the tectonic backend is a CI failure: the entry is stale and must be removed in the same change that made it green (the account may not rot).
Every entry names the phase that turns it green and the tectonic2 unit it waits on; an entry without both is invalid and fails the account check.
The FrameCore backend (br-sidecar-fc) never reads this file: every leg stays red-is-red there until that arm is retired.
Line numbers are the verify.py print(...) lines at block-reality f8a656f; the tag is authoritative, the line is a courtesy.

legs.why: shell self-weight conservation is asserted against the (n-1)^2 facet area of the old mesh; tectonic's area is n^2.
